summary: ILSENG SANGFORENING (org. no. 976 795 555) is an association (FLI), in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-10-10. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 90.201 (Utøvende kunstnerisk virksomhet og underholdningsvirksomhet innenfor musikk); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Rita Bråthen.
